title: Aimaq dialect
description: Persian dialect of the Aimaq people of northwest Afghanistan
extract: Aimaq or Aimaqi is a Persian dialect and the dominant eastern Persian ethnolect spoken by the Aimaq people in central northwest Afghanistan and eastern Iran. It is close to the Dari varieties of Persian. The Aimaq people are thought to have a 5–15% literacy rate.
